Print resolved G-TROPIC filters

Source: R/class_gtropic_data.R
print.gtropic_filters.Rd

Displays each resolved filter with a compact value preview. Long vectors, such as selected ADM2 identifiers, show at most n values and state how many values were omitted. The complete values remain available through ordinary list access.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gtropic_filters'
print(x, n = 10L, ...)

Arguments

x

A gtropic_filters object returned by gtropic_filters().

n

Maximum number of values to display for each filter.

...

Additional arguments passed to the print method. Currently ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

# \donttest{
res <- gtropic_data(WHO_ENTITY = "Philippines", date_range = c(2015, 2016))
